tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dgongs pa yang zab kyi smin grol sbyin pa'i tho yig bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru/ rtsa ba gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi// smin grol sbyin pa'i go rim ni| |dmar khrid sbrag dang rkyang pa'i tshul// gnyis las dbang khrid sbrag pa na// them byang gter byung lo rgyus dang*// gter yig 'bebs pa'i bskur byang dang*// dag snang gdung sel kha byang dang*// gter sgrub lung bstan yi ge yi// phyi mor bcas rnams bklag lung bya// de nas rtsa gsum gtor dbang gis// chos sgo phyes nas sngon 'gro'i khrid// gdab bo de rjes byin rlabs ni// bla ma'i smin grol sbyin pa'i sngon| |pad+ma saṃ bha'i lha khrid gdab// de rjes gro lod tshe dbang 'dzin// bdud 'dul rgyal po rnams kyi dbang*// bskur zhing rang rang lha khrid spel| |yang dril sgrub thabs thugs sgrub sbyin// de nas bla ma'i smin grol lo// de rjes yi dam smin grol ni// zhi khro'i dbang phreng sbyor dngos rjes// bskur nas zhi ba rigs bsdus kyi// phyi nang gsang sgrub lha khrid gdab// rang rang las tshogs lung dang spel| |de rjes khro bo rigs bsdus kyi// phyi nang gsang sgrub khrid lung sbrag /de rjes 'chi med phyi dbang bskur// nang gsang gnas dus yul la dpag |tshe yi las byang ji bzhin du// lha khrid gdab cing slar yang ni// 'dod chags rang grol gdams pa bstan// de rjes rgyun khyer gwa'u ma// byin la long skabs rgyas pa na// yang zab rlung gi gdams pa sbyin// de rjes mkha' 'gro'i smin grol te// phag lnga'i dbang bskur lha khrid ni// phyi nang gsang bar bcas pa gdab// de rjes gtum mo la sogs pa'i// chos lnga sbyin pa de yi rjes// bka' srung dbang bskur de'i rdzogs rim// yang dag mchog gcig khrid du gdab// de rjes gnod sbyin gwa'u yi// dbang dang lha khrid spel te sbyin// de rjes gnod sbyin spun gsum gyi// rjes gnang lha khrid dag kyang spel// der ma 'thus pa'i chos sde rnams// bklag lung skabs dang sbyar la bya// bka' srung srog gtad khrag thigs ni// shin tu gnyan pas dam par bya// de ltar grub nas snying byang gi// thugs rje gcig la smin byas te// snang mtha' spyan gzigs rta mgrin gsum// so sor phyi nang gsang sgrub kyi// lha khrid byin mthar snod ldan la// ha ri'i bka' gtad byas nas kyang*// de yi phyi nang gsang sgrub rnams// khrid du gdab bo tshul des ni// dgongs pa yang zab smin lam dang*// lha khrid zin no rdzogs pa'i rim// ye shes kun rdzogs ji lta bar// lag len gnad dang bcas pa sbyin// de rjes khregs chod thod rgal gyi// ngo sprod lag bcang tshig gsum pa'i// rgyud ltar gnad du smin gdab gces// yang na lha khrid mi byed na// rtsa gsum gtor dbang gis smin nas// sngon 'gro'i khrid dang de yi rjes// dngos gzhi ye shes kun rdzogs gdab// rjes su ngo sprod lag bcang nyid// 'khrul med sbyin no de yis grub// zhib pa'i lag len myong ba'i gnad// 'ga' 'ga' mchis pa zhal las longs// de skad smras pa 'bri gung pa// skyu ra'i gdung las grags pa'i ming*// lha sras skye bar khas 'che ba// kho bos bgyis so la la dag

/rang bzo'i 'thad legs gya tshom gyis// brtsams chos mang mthong e ma mtshar// rang nor rang gis longs spyod par// 'gran pa'i blun po 'ga' mchis pa// chos srung rnams kyis ma mthong ngam// zhes pa shing lug rang lo ni// re gcig la bab dbur stod kyi// klung shod rtse ba gzhis kar bris// //maṅga laṃ//
